messages:
sam: hey team :wave: I'm wrapping up my first feature branch and want to make the PR as acceptable as possible. quick questions: branch naming, commit message format, and whether we squash. also any local checks I should run before opening the PR?

marta: welcome! :tada: branch names are `feat/<team>-short-desc` or `fix/<team>-short-desc` for bugfixes. keep it under ~4 words.

jon: commit messages follow Conventional Commits-ish but simplified: feat(scope): short summary. include a longer body only if necessary and reference issue/ctx. example:
```
feat(auth): add session refresh for refresh_token expiry

- adds refresh flow to client
- adds integration test for token rotate

Refs: #42
```

marta: PRs should generally be squash-merged unless it's a big refactor and you explicitly ask to preserve history. squash title should mirror the summary line.

alex: run these locally before opening: `git fetch && make deps && make lint && make test` (python stack). for frontend `yarn && yarn lint && yarn test`. we have pre-commit hooks that run `black`/`prettier` and some safety checks. if pre-commit fails, run `pre-commit run --all-files` to fix.

sam: thanks — where do I find the CODEOWNERS / who to tag for reviews?

marta: CODEOWNERS at repo root. if you're touching runtime, tag @jon; infra -> @alex. otherwise `@eng` is fine for an initial ping. also add labels: `needs-review` and `size/XS|S|M` depending on risk.

jon: small note on CI: we require 2 approvals from engineers outside your immediate reviewer + green checks. the pipeline name is `ci/main` and `ci/security`. if `ci/security` fails on dependency scan, open a security-prioritization thread.

ci-bot: ci/main failed on latest push — pytest 1 failure in tests/test_token_rotate.py::test_refresh_flow (flaky? rerun with `--flake`?)

alex: if CI flakes, add `retry` label and re-run the workflow from the Actions UI. but try to reproduce locally first (use `pytest -k test_refresh_flow -q`).

sam: awesome, this helps a lot. one last question: are small docs changes required in the PR body?

marta: yes please add a short bullet list in PR body: what changed, why, testing done, rollout plan (if anything). if no user-visible changes, add `changelog/skip`.

sam: perfect — I'll tidy the branch name, run pre-commit, fix the failing test, and open the PR with the template. thanks everyone! :pray:

jon: ping me on the PR and I'll take the first look. welcome aboard :party_parrot:
